title: H4 fix round 2: the per-goal reservation cap must not treat the per-run hard cap as a goal budget (it refuses the second parallel dispatch of any role); apply a goal-level cap only where a goal budget exists and estimate from recent runs first (gate_red on T-0392)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain ade6b74, 530c2ab and c1ba47c (T-0362, T-0392) in git log; never drop or amend them.
Gate red on T-0392, reproduced on a clean external run, two failures: tests/test_daemon.py::Daemon::test_depends_on_gates_dispatch (Lists differ: ['T-0001'] != ['T-0001', 'T-0002'], the second ready task is no longer dispatched) and tests/test_pool.py::Reservations::test_goal_role_cap_refuses_when_goal_spend_plus_reservations_exceed_cap (unexpectedly None: the allowed case is refused). Cause: c1ba47c reads role_cap from [limits].max_budget_usd[role], which is the per-run hard cap (execute 6.0 USD), and the estimate for a new reservation is that same cap, so goal_spend + live reservations + est exceeds the "cap" as soon as a second run of the role starts in the same goal; every parallel dispatch of one role is refused.
Fix: (1) separate the two concepts: per-run cap ([limits].max_budget_usd[role]) is only an estimate ceiling, never a goal cap; the goal-level guard applies only when a goal budget for the role is configured ([review].budget_usd for role review, plus an optional new [limits].goal_budget_usd table, default absent = no goal-level cap). Daily account token budgets keep working as before. (2) Estimate order: median tokens and usd of that role's last 20 run rows when at least 5 exist, else the per-run cap. (3) Rewrite test_goal_role_cap_refuses_when_goal_spend_plus_reservations_exceed_cap to use a configured goal budget (over refuses, under allows) and add test_two_parallel_execute_dispatches_allowed_without_goal_budget (two reserve calls for role execute in one goal with only per-run caps configured both succeed). test_depends_on_gates_dispatch must pass unchanged.
Keep the five T-0362 tests and the T-0392 tests green (adjust test_exhausted_hold_releases_dispatch_reservation only if the estimate change requires). Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0 (whole suite), then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows c1ba47c, 530c2ab and ade6b74 below your commit
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
